# MIDI fixtures written by other programs

Used by `tests/midi-realdaw-files.test.ts` and `tests/midi-bitwig-export.test.ts`. Total of the six MIDI files 27,244 bytes. Licence is the one the Wikimedia Commons file page states (read 2026-11-26); the four Commons files are public domain or CC0, so no attribution is required. File page: `https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:<file>`.

`d-bitwig-rich-expected.json` (37,630 bytes) is what the SDK wrote into the project Bitwig exported: every note (track, beat, pitch, velocity 1..127, duration, channel), the controller and pitch-bend events, the tempo and meter maps. It is not a MIDI file; the test compares the Bitwig file against it.
